messages:
Priya Sharma: Quick kickoff — CypressHealth wants a POC to replace OrchidAPI with Redwood. Key asks: prompt/response parity, billing delta, KMS + SOC2, EU data residency. Target: 3-week evaluation. Who can lead technical side?
Alex Kim: I can own infra + perf. Need sample traffic (top ~2k prompts) and their current streaming shape.
Jordan Lee: Sales note — they're worried about token accounting differences. Request: pricing delta estimate and migration credit.
Samir Patel: I'll build a compatibility façade that exposes Orchid-like endpoints and maps to Redwood. Plan: endpoint mapping, response-field normalization, stream shim. Need the exact Orchid sample responses to match frames.
Elena (SE): @Samir can you also capture header semantics? They rely on X-Org-Role and a per-call client_id header.
Samir Patel: Yep. Will preserve headers and map to metadata. Example shim curl for testing:```bash
curl -X POST 'https://poc.redwood.local/orchid/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'X-Org-Role: clinician' \n  -d '{"prompt":"<user prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```
Jordan Lee: Pricing — can we offer a migration credit? They asked for 3 months of cost parity. Propose 30% credit first 90 days and a price-review after.
Alex Kim: For perf, I'll provision a small Dedicated pool (eu-west) and pin model to rdx-2.1-small to hit their latency targets.
SecurityBot: Redwood Security: SOC2 Type II in place. KMS options: AWS KMS, GCP CMEK; Private deployment supports customer HSM. SSO SAML + IP allowlist available. Need completed security questionnaire PDF.
Elena (SE): CypressHealth requires EU-only processing + audit log retention 12 months. @SecurityBot can we do EU-only with Private control plane?
SecurityBot: Yes — Private deployment in eu-west-1 satisfies EU residency. Addendum required for data processing terms.
doc-bot: Uploaded cypress-poc-checklist.pdf
Priya Sharma: Blocker callout — their client uses a custom chunked streaming format with intermittent 'meta' frames. We must match it exactly or their client will break. Samir can you emulate the exact frame types?
Samir Patel: Yes. We'll implement an SSE wrapper that emits the same frames. Pseudo mapping below:```js
// pseudo shim for Orchid streaming frames
function handleFrame(frame) {
  if (frame.type === 'delta') send('data: ' + JSON.stringify({token: frame.t}));
  if (frame.type === 'meta') send('event: meta\n data: ' + JSON.stringify(frame.meta));
  if (frame.type === 'end') send('event: done\n data: {}\n\n');
}
```
Jordan Lee: Evaluation metrics — they want: token-cost delta, latency P95, regressions in intent extraction, hallucination count on clinical prompts.
Alex Kim: I'll stand up the eval harness and run A/B: Orchid vs Redwood-mapped. Need the 2k prompt corpus and expected labels.
Priya Sharma: Legal flagged one more blocker: contractual SLA for availability and a rollback plan. We can offer canary + automatic fallback to Orchid during rollouts.
Elena (SE): Security questionnaire deadline: Tue EOD. I'll draft answers today — @Priya please attach the questionnaire here.
Priya Sharma: Sent — attaching completed sections as I go. Also proposing onboarding timeline: Week0 infra + shim; Week1 smoke + streaming parity; Week2 evaluation and metrics; Week3 decision + contracting.
Jordan Lee: Sounds good. I'll draft the pricing proposal and migration credit terms and post for review by EOD tomorrow.
Samir Patel: Action list for me: 1) implement endpoint shim, 2) add header passthrough & SSE frame emulator, 3) run smoke tests with Alex, 4) produce comparison snapshots.
SecurityBot: Reminder: provide completed questionnaire + contact for DPO. We will also need a short architecture diagram for the Private deployment.
Priya Sharma: Thanks team. If no objections I'll schedule a kickoff with CypressHealth for Monday 09:00 CET.
Elena (SE): No objections. I'll join and bring the security answers.
Alex Kim: I'll have infra ready by Friday for an initial smoke.
Jordan Lee: I'll confirm pricing language and attach to the thread. :thumbsup:
Priya Sharma: Great — marking this thread as the single source of truth for the POC. I'll update with artifacts as they land.
